title: Image Gallery
description: A gallery that presents images in grid, masonry, or slideshow layouts.

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description: How to present the images in the gallery.

attributes.name: active-index
attributes.description: Index of the active image to start on in gallery mode.

example_html: <image-gallery mode="masonry"><media-image source="https://dummyimage.com/300x200/000/fff" alt="Sample image 1"></media-image><media-image source="https://dummyimage.com/300x300/111/eee" alt="Sample image 2"></media-image><media-image source="https://dummyimage.com/400x200/222/ddd" alt="Sample image 3"></media-image></image-gallery>
